verdict.rationale: QuickBooks provides both a natural-language AI chat (Intuit Intelligence, quickbooks-docs-19/20/29) that answers questions grounded in real financial data, and a separate official MCP server exposing 145 tools covering the full QBO API (quickbooks-gh-3, quickbooks-probe-3), which would let an external agent query live ledger data to answer affordability questions. However, there's no direct evidence of the specific 'can we afford X' affordability-reasoning use case, no OpenAPI spec discoverable (quickbooks-probe-2 404s), and no independent/hands-on validation of the MCP server or Intuit Intelligence answering financial questions accurately. missing for 10: evidence of an agent actually answering a live affordability question end-to-end via the API/MCP server, discoverable OpenAPI schema, independent hands-on validation of grounded accuracy.
